results.name: no-edit save of every readable corpus workbook returns the original bytes
corpus edit session: change a number, add a bold text cell, re-style a cell — openpyxl sees exactly those edits and nothing else lost
charts, comments, conditional formats, data validation, images and theme-coloured fonts survive an edit; only edited parts change
cached values: a formula depending on an edited cell is re-cached (data_only reader sees the new result); calcChain dropped + fullCalcOnLoad
sheet rename, add, delete and reorder; merges, column widths, freeze panes and validations written; definedNames follow the rename
style derivation keeps theme colours and font face/size of the original cell
Strict OOXML workbooks (openpyxl cannot read them): edit round-trips through our reader, namespaces kept, no part lost

conditional formats are imported for display: every constant cellIs rule (numeric or string operand; rgb, theme+tint or indexed colours) matches an independent reading (openpyxl rules + lxml dxfs + colorsys tint)
